summary: Researched perplexity-based AI code detection (found AAAI 2024 paper matching team's avg+variance+burstiness idea, and 2025 caveat paper on perplexity's limited standalone accuracy); designed weighted flag-scoring formula combining peer similarity, AI-reference similarity, perplexity z-score, and watermark score; provided CodeGen-350M-multi based free/local perplexity implementation.
